elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Kubient must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies a USD 2,000,000 aggregate limit.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber liability insurance where Kubient collects, processes, or stores data on Customer's behalf. This supplies the required conditional obligation without relying on the margin comment.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The clause states that Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 E&O limit exceeds the fallback USD 1,000,000 limit.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause conditionally requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber liability insurance where Kubient collects, processes, or stores data on Customer's behalf, exceeding the fallback limit.

result.reason: The preferred position is not fully satisfied because workers' compensation insurance is omitted. The stated fallback limits are satisfied because the clause requires USD 2 million of E&O and USD 5 million of conditional cyber coverage. The redline is not minimal because it adds a one-year post-Term insurance tail not required by either position. It preserves the existing assignment and integration terms, but drafting quality is reduced by placing the insurance provision in an unrelated assignment/entire-agreement subsection and by omitting workers' compensation.
